ways.title: Command line
ways.use: Make a lockfile and check it from a terminal.

ways.title: Desktop app
ways.use: You are in it. Click a New robot starter, or open your own lockfile.

ways.title: GitHub Action
ways.use: Run the check on every push and keep an HTML report.
code:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: Shivansh2703/lockwire@v0
  with:
    contract: lockwire.yaml

ways.title: AI agents (MCP)
ways.use: Let Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor check your robot before it acts.
code: claude mcp add lockwire -- lockwire mcp
ways.note: Claude Code: the claude mcp add line. Claude Desktop: put the JSON in claude_desktop_config.json. Cursor: put the JSON in .cursor/mcp.json (or ~/.cursor/mcp.json). If the app cannot find lockwire, use the full path from which lockwire. Then ask: Check my robot's lockwire.yaml and explain the NO-GO.

ways.title: Agent plan and what-if
ways.use: Score an intended plan, or a proposed change, before anything executes.
code: lockwire what-if lockwire.yaml --change "devices/dev.onboard-computer/physical/mass=300 g" --source "my scale" --witness me
ways.note: plan.yaml holds steps, for example: steps: [{kind: rail_load, rail: rail.supply-5v, draw: {value: 10, unit: W}}]

ways.title: Python library
ways.use: Call the same check from your own script.

ways.title: ROS, preflight and the local API
ways.use: The go/no-go gate for a powered-on robot, ROS and the local server.

features.name: Check
features.how: See which numbers do not add up.

features.name: Declare a fact
features.how: Set one value with a source and a witness.
features.code: lockwire declare lockwire.yaml devices/dev.power-module.pm02-v3/physical/mass "25 g" --source "my scale" --witness me

features.name: Add a part
features.how: Add a device, rail, bus or battery block.

features.name: Design (place, move, rotate, reparent)
features.how: Put a part in the 3D model and move it. Switch on the Power, Data and Mechanical connection views to see them drawn on the robot, and use W, A, S, D to move the camera.
features.code: lockwire move lockwire.yaml dev.power-module.pm02-v3 --offset 0.01,0,0.02 --unit m --source "tape measure" --witness me

features.name: Plan and what-if
features.how: Score a plan or a change without editing the lockfile.

features.name: Report
features.how: Write one HTML page to share.

features.name: Describe
features.how: Write a reference sheet per part.

features.name: History (diff, log, blame)
features.how: See what changed, by whom, and why (needs git).

features.name: Scene
features.how: Read part positions from a 3D model.

features.name: Gearbox
features.how: Add a gearbox with its ratio and joints.

features.name: Upgrade
features.how: Write a new lockfile from an older one.
